transcript_text: Sales Executive: How did you find the apartment? Aarav: We liked the 2 BHK, but my main concern is the monthly EMI. My wife wants to see it again. Sales Executive: We can arrange a family visit and ask our finance desk to explain payment structures. Aarav: Saturday afternoon may work. Please send options. I do not want to commit before checking the numbers.
evidence_excerpt: “My main concern is the monthly EMI.”

transcript_text: Sales Executive: Shall we review the quote? Priya: The layout is good, but the total price is higher than another property I saw. I need a clear reason to pay more. Sales Executive: I can send an itemised comparison and check alternate units. Priya: Send the breakdown first. I will compare this week, but I cannot promise anything.
evidence_excerpt: “The total price is higher than another property I saw.”

transcript_text: Sales Manager: What questions remain? Kabir: I like the project, but my father needs to understand the location and numbers. I am also unsure this unit is the right fit. Sales Manager: We can arrange a meeting and compare two available units with full costs. Kabir: That would help. If he is comfortable and the alternative fits better, we can move forward.
evidence_excerpt: “My father needs to understand the location and the numbers.”
recommended_intervention: Joint stakeholder meeting + alternate-unit cost sheet

transcript_text: Sales Executive: Ready to discuss next steps? Sana: The bank has not confirmed my loan. I will not pay a booking amount until I know the loan is possible. They asked for updated income documents, which I submitted. Sales Executive: I can share a checklist and coordinate with our finance desk, but the bank makes the approval decision. Sana: Please send it. If approval does not come through, I must pause.
key_signals: Loan approval pending; explicit booking blocker
evidence_excerpt: “I will not pay a booking amount until I know the loan is possible.”

transcript_text: Sales Executive: How did the 2 BHK feel? Dev: It was good. I am also talking to another project. Will this unit still be available? Sales Executive: I will verify live inventory and explain the formal hold process. I cannot promise a hold before confirmation. Dev: Please check quickly. I could return this evening. Message me before 1 PM.

Sales Executive: Were you able to review the schedule? Isha: Yes, but the milestone payment dates are compressed. I want to know exactly what is due at foundation and superstructure. Sales Executive: I can send the construction link and milestone calendar. Isha: Send that. If the milestone dates are realistic, I will proceed with the booking form.
evidence_excerpt: “If the milestone dates are realistic, I will proceed with the booking form.”

transcript_text: Senior Sales Consultant: Following up on the commercial suite proposal. Arjun: The price is okay, but your projected rental yield looks aggressive. A 7.5% return in this corridor seems unlikely in year one. Senior Sales Consultant: I can share the lease-assumption note and realistic range. Arjun: Please do. If the numbers do not hold under conservative assumptions, I will look elsewhere.
recommended_intervention: Documented yield breakdown + realistic scenario model

transcript_text: Sales Executive: Did you select a preference between the two towers? Mira: Tower B has a better view, but Tower A has a better floor plate. My brother wants to walk through Tower B before we decide. Sales Executive: We can host you both on Sunday morning. Mira: Confirm Sunday 11 AM. If the light and view match what you described, we will finalize.
evidence_excerpt: “Confirm Sunday 11 AM. If the light and view match, we will finalize.”
